```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
```

## Results Overview

Below are the statewide vote totals for the candidates in the 2026 Republican primary election for Governor across Florida's 67 counties.

```{r}
#| label: plot-governor-primary

# Locate all county result files
files <- list.files("data", pattern = "\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)

# Read tab-delimited files and filter for the Republican gubernatorial primary
gov_results <- read_tsv(
  files,
  col_names = c(
    "county_code", "county_name", "election_id", "election_date",
    "election_name", "precinct_id", "precinct_name", "total_registered",
    "ballots_cast", "blank1", "blank2", "contest", "district",
    "contest_code", "candidate", "party", "party_num", "doe_id", "votes"
  ),
  col_types = cols(
    .default = col_character(),
    votes = col_double()
  )
) |>
  filter(contest == "Governor", party == "REP") |>
  summarize(total_votes = sum(votes, na.rm = TRUE), .by = candidate)

# Create a horizontal bar chart of vote totals
gov_results |>
  ggplot(aes(x = total_votes, y = fct_reorder(candidate, total_votes))) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(
    title = "2026 Florida Republican Primary: Governor",
    subtitle = "Total votes by candidate across all 67 counties",
    x = "Total Votes",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
